title: lists object.value
description: The object of a statement under https://registry.trustoverip.org/dtg/vsc/lists/1: what kind of party the network lists, and the governance framework the listing is made under. Acknowledgement state is deliberately absent: it is derived from the listing's companions (a completed VMC pair, or a repudiates/1 statement), never asserted by the network. The member set is part of this predicate version and is frozen with it once the version leaves draft.

nodeType.description: Whether the listed party is a community (its entries are members) or a network (its entries are further listings) — VTI-VTN-031. Values are those of the DTG nodeType vocabulary for these two node types.

framework.description: The governance framework the listing is made under, and the version relied on (VTI-VTN-002, VTI-VTN-023, VTI-REG-002).
